name: jj-equity

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: node desktop/prepare-assets.cjs && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:intelligence && node desktop/extract-geography.cjs && npm run build && npm run test:desktop && npm run desktop:prepare && npm run desktop:source && npm run desktop:package

description: J&J Equity personal market and intelligence research workspace
